answer: Mechanism: statistical identity merging. A beacon-seeded sampler two-sample-tests each agent's public behavior: embeddings, timing, counterparty graphs. Statistically indistinguishable identities merge into one virtual voter of weight one: a clone farm becomes a sable mirror of a single honest peer, paying N times fees for one plume of influence. Each merge mints an ember of suspicion: correlated funding forfeits all member bonds. Honest distinct behavior never merges. Attacker cost: linear per clone, zero marginal voting power, rising forfeiture each epoch - cloning is negative EV.
